Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and agreed next steps so we have the same page: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for internal search augmentation and customer reply suggestion workflows. Primary success metric: 15-20% increase in relevant click-through for search + F1 >= 0.78 on reply suggestions compared to current baseline.
- POC length: 4 weeks (target kickoff Mon 6/14).
- Data: Acme will share 3 months of anonymized search logs + a sample set of 2k customer replies (see sample_data_mapping.xlsx).
- Success criteria: defined above + latency target for 95th pctile < 300ms for short requests.
- Ownership: Alyssa (Acme) — product lead; Tom (Acme) — data/infra; Marissa — commercial; Laura — CS; Dev — SE for tech integration.
- Next steps: Acme to send sample exports by EOD Thu (6/11). Redwood to share SOW and initial config (RDW_POC_SOW_v1.pdf).

I attached the SOW and a scope worksheet (RDW_POC_Scope_v2.xlsx) that maps features to success criteria. If anything important is missing, flag it and we can adjust prior to kickoff.

Looking forward —

Hi all —

Quick note after reviewing the sample mapping: adding KB Q&A as a stretch objective is doable with minimal infra changes. Details: 

- Integration: We can reuse the same ingest pipeline; we'll need a new prompt/template and a small retrieval layer (vector index) — recommend Pinecone/managed vector or your existing ES. For the POC we'll provision a temporary vectordb in the Redwood sandbox.
- Evaluation: Aditya can run an additional F1/EM eval on the 2-3k QA pairs; should take ~2 business days to instrument and run once we have the data.
- Latency/Cost: Expect +8-12% per-token cost for retrieval+rank; 95th pctile latency may increase by ~50ms depending on index size. Not a blocker but should be in the rebaseline.
- Ops: We'll add a second route in the POC config so we can toggle KB Q&A on/off without redeploy.

If Acme wants this gated by a week-2 pass, we can include it as an optional workstream in the SOW (no change to overall 4-week length; some evaluation steps will shift into week 3).

I'll draft a brief rebaseline note for Alyssa.

—Dev

Marissa / team —

I ran a quick simulation on our side with a representative sample and here's what I'd recommend for success criteria if we add KB Q&A as a stretch: 

- Primary: Answer accuracy (Exact Match) >= 0.70 and F1 >= 0.72 on the 2-3k QA set.
- Secondary: Confidence calibration / precision@k for top-1 >= 0.78 so we don't surface low-quality answers.
- Gate at end of week 2: if search + reply targets are met, enable KB Q&A eval in week 3.

I'll prepare the eval harness and a short notebook (share link in Drive) so Acme can reproduce locally. Time estimate: 3 business days to integrate and produce results once data is in.

-Aditya
